newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ICE Securities starts Csopak with 'buy'.
newsitem.headline: ICE Securities starts Csopak with 'buy'.

text.p: London-based ICE Securities started coverage of Hungarian retail group Csopak Rt with a 'buy' recommendation, saying the shares represent a good value at current prices.

"Whilst the share price has already more than doubled this year, given the company's outstanding growth potential, our short to medium-term price target is 3,500 to 4,000 forints," said analyst Rudi Voros in a company report, dated June 19.
"We believe that on current levels the shares represent good value and, accordingly, we recommend purchases," he said.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange at 0929 GMT Csopak shares traded at 2,850 forints, up 20 from Friday's close.
Voros said ICE expected Csopak to benefit from the strengthening of consumers' purchasing power and as a result from the pick-up in retail and wholesale trade.

"In addition to being a well managed, quality company, the share prices should also benefit from its scarcity value, due to a lack of investment opportunities in the Hungarian retail sector," he said.
